subject: Short exec walkthrough + recording? (Novaplane pilot)
messages:
From: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@novaplane.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@novaplane.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: 30-minute exec walkthrough + recording (Novaplane pilot)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro last week — Novaplane is excited about the pilot. Our CIO and a couple of platform leads want a short executive walkthrough focused on how Redwood handles multi-tenant routing and cost controls. High-level ask: something tight (25-30 minutes) that hits the architecture and the fallbacks.

Would a 30-minute slot with a brief Q&A work? They prefer late afternoons PST on the week of Nov 8–12. If the exec prefers not to be recorded we can omit recording, otherwise it helps our procurement and SRE review.

Attached a one-pager (Novaplane-Pilot-MAP.pdf) with the use cases and expected attendees.

Potential attendees on our side: Maya Tan (CIO), Elena Ruiz (Head of Platform), and one procurement contact (procurement@novaplane.com).

Can you confirm who from Redwood should be on the call (VP/CTO/solutions lead)?

Best,
Aaron
Aaron Liu
Senior Solutions Manager | Novaplane
+1 415 555 0192

--
Attachment: Novaplane-Pilot-MAP.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Quick ask: 30-minute exec walkthrough + recording (Novaplane pilot)

Hi Aaron — thanks for the note and the one-pager. We can absolutely do a tight 30-minute exec walkthrough.

Quick answers:
- Recommended Redwood attendees: myself (Head of Solutions), Marcus Lin (Platform PM lead) — Marcus can handle the architecture and routing details — and Laura Bennett (Customer Success) to cover onboarding/timeline.
- We prefer a short runbook: 20 minutes demo + 10 minutes Q&A. If Maya wants to focus on procurement/SLA questions we can keep the recording for internal review, otherwise we will mark the recording off.

Availability for our execs the week of Nov 8–12 (PST):
- Tue Nov 9: 3:00–3:45pm PT
- Wed Nov 10: 4:00–4:45pm PT
- Thu Nov 11: 2:00–2:45pm PT (Marcus is only available before 3pm this day)

If none of those work we can extend to Nov 15–16 and keep the same timebox. I can send a calendar hold once you confirm the preferred slot and recording preference.

Also looping Marcus and Laura here to confirm they can cover the technical and success parts. Marcus — can you prepare a 12-minute architecture walkthrough focused on routing policies, failover, and a quick cost/latency tradeoff slide?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
